zh-CN.title: 游戏房间可以发快捷语音
items: 游戏房间右下角增加快捷语音，第一条可以提醒牌友出牌。
斗地主和双扣会在要不起时提示，5 秒后自动过牌。

en.title: Send quick voice messages in game rooms
items: Open quick voice in the bottom right of your game room to send a turn reminder or another preset line.
Dou Dizhu and Shuangkou now tell you when you have no legal response and pass after five seconds.
